**What would you like to add?**

A model improvement, a demo, a verification section, tooling, docs — anything.

**Which roadmap item does this fit?**

See Part 17 of the README (Easy / Medium / Advanced). If it's new, propose
where it belongs.

**How will it be verified or measured?**

This project's rule: every change carries a proof (equivalence check, test)
or a measurement (val loss, tok/s, cache bytes). Please sketch which one
applies — e.g. "extend §8 of verify.py", "add a test to tests/test_bpe.py",
"benchmark.py gains a row".
